name: web/SQLi error-based MySQL-family
description: [high] Proves error-based SQLi on the MySQL/MariaDB family: a broken quote makes the server return dialect-specific errors (You have an error in your SQL syntax / MariaDB server version / Mysql2::Error / ER_PARSE_ERROR / mysqlnd) = server-side SQL interpretation, MySQL dialect (complements the existing PostgreSQL skill). Keywords: sqli error-based mysql mariadb syntax exception injection. ctrl: benign POST shows no driver error -> not falsified. probe_url = JSON endpoint echoing 'name' into SQL.
